decisive_spans.text: p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers
Several foci showed papillary projections lined by multilayered epithelium with atypical cells, few mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis but no dermal invasion

response.rationale: The vignette describes a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, papillary projections, and p63 positive staining in myoepithelial cells, which are all highly characteristic of Hidradenoma papilliferum. While Syringocystadenoma papilliferum shares some features, the presence of atypical cells, mitotic figures, and necrosis, along with the absence of dermal invasion, makes Hidradenoma papilliferum a more fitting diagnosis.
